instruction: Why do we even need to learn matrices? When will I ever use this in real life?
output: A fair and practical question! Think of the mining operations on the Copperbelt or large inventory warehouses in Lusaka. When engineers manage tons of copper ore, equipment schedules, and transportation costs across different shifts, they don't do it with single numbers—they use matrices to compute millions of data points at once. Learning matrices is learning the language of data and engineering!
